repository_model: independent product repositories with an integration hub

products.name: VHAGAR
products.current_status: Existing research code; Southern validation remains a separate task.
products.planned_scope: Southern validation, reliable event delivery, prescribed-burn context and reviewed evidence workflows as defined by the relevant pilot. Portfolio organisation does not establish operational readiness.

products.name: Vaughan
products.current_status: Existing hurricane research code; flood and coastal-impact extensions are planned.
products.planned_scope: Observed flood extent, event-related coastal inundation and shoreline disturbance, exposed-asset screening, access and inspection priorities, and recovery evidence. None of these additions is claimed to be implemented by this scope change.

products.name: Vulcan
products.domain: Mineral prospectivity, mineral rights and permits
products.current_status: Existing experimental prospectivity framework; rights and permit workflows are planned.
products.planned_scope: A jurisdiction-aware register of mineral rights, leases, claims and operating/environmental permits; document provenance, legal-description and geometry links, recorded status, review dates, and observed-activity comparisons. This requires records integration and specialist review, not satellite imagery alone.

products.name: Vantage
products.current_status: Design stage; no implementation or validated agriculture service.
products.planned_scope: First test: support an independent crop consultant prioritising field and zone inspections in irrigated upland cotton in Hale and Floyd counties, Texas. Proposed pilot: 3-5 growers and 20-40 fields, with farmer records and independent scouting. Broader crop, pasture and farm-water services require separate design and validation.

products.name: Vepris
products.current_status: Design stage; scope documented, implementation pending.
products.planned_scope: Forest-condition and canopy-change screening, drought/stress investigation support, harvest and clearing histories, replanting, vegetation recovery, storm-disturbance documentation and timberland portfolio reporting.

products.name: Viga
products.current_status: Awaiting owner-led separation from LillieWatch; documentation only.
products.planned_scope: Reusable oil-spill candidate detection, review and evidence workflows. After the owner publishes the separated code, review packaging, provenance, data rights, test evidence and regional suitability before selecting a source pin and integration method.

products.name: Velo
products.current_status: Design stage; no implementation or validated water-intelligence service.
products.planned_scope: Routine water availability and reservoir/surface-water histories, watershed context, regional groundwater indicators where suitable, locally validated water-quality and bloom screening, and sampling/inspection prioritisation. Select one customer, region and decision before implementing a broad platform.
